derived.name: etf_flow_btc_daily
transformations: flow rows are parsed from the raw html table (blank cell = 0 USD m, counted)
BTC close is joined on the UTC calendar date of the Binance daily kline
no interpolation, no filling, no resampling: missing BTC closes stay null

pit_convention.rationale: the provider publishes final daily flows after the US cash session; the exact historical publication timestamp per day is not published, so availability is never taken at face value: PIT_STATUS = UNKNOWN and the strategy side uses the declared conservative rule above
pit_convention.aggressive_rule_reported_for_contrast_on: flow_date at 00:00:00Z (assumes the number existed before it did)
